title: Mixtral of Experts
authors: A. Jiang, A. Sablayrolles, A. Roux, et al.
before: Mixture-of-experts models were built and kept inside large labs.
problem: Nobody outside those labs could study or deploy a sparse model.
breakthrough: An open sparse MoE, 47B total parameters with about 13B active per token, matching much larger dense models.
why: It brought MoE into the open ecosystem and made the total-versus-active parameter distinction common knowledge.
next: DeepSeekMoE, Llama 4, Kimi and the open MoE era.
inherits: Sparse open models as a normal deployment option.
